verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents interact with the Stripe API, so users can operate invoicing through natural language via an external agent. There is no evidence of a built-in natural-language command interface in the Invoicing Dashboard itself, and the MCP evidence is a single thin line. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language commands, documentation of invoicing-specific MCP tools and actions, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Let your AI agents interact with the Stripe API by using our MCP server.
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
